india_trends.summary: The Nifty 50 paused its four-session recovery on Tuesday, closing at 23,329 after facing selling pressure. india_trends.title: Why are foreign investors leaving Indian stocks? Bernstein flags ‘bygone’ large-cap businesses, low AI exposure
india_trends.summary: In September, overseas investors began selling Indian equities, influenced by concerns over high valuations and limited AI market exposure. Bernstein highlights that many large Indian firms are struggling to adapt, diminishing their attractiveness to foreign investors amid changing technologies.

india_trends.summary: The National Stock Exchange's IPO, initially projected as India's largest, concluded at ₹22,562 crore, making it the second-largest. Despite this, demand was substantial, with bids exceeding issue size by over ₹90,000 crore, indicating robust market interest.

india_trends.title: Hill-house backed Elevate Campuses raises Rs 945-crore anchor book
india_trends.summary: Hillhouse-backed Elevate Campuses raised Rs 945 crore from 20 anchor investors, including major mutual funds and Norges. The amount represents 60% of its QIB allocation ahead of its Rs 2,100 crore IPO, which opens Wednesday and closes Friday.

india_trends.title: Runwal Enterprises sets IPO price band at Rs 290-305 per share
india_trends.summary: Runwal Enterprises has set its IPO price band at Rs 290-305 per share, with the Rs 500 crore fresh issue opening Friday and closing September 29. The Mumbai-focused developer has 88.37 million square feet of developable area across residential and non-residential projects.

india_trends.title: Market Trading Guide: Finolex Cables among 3 stock recommendations for Wednesday
india_trends.summary: Falling crude oil prices and Brent slipping below $100 a barrel helped Indian markets recover from intraday lows. india_trends.summary: Circle Internet Group and Binance have formed a five-year partnership, with Binance investing $100 million in Circle. This deal aims to expand USDC usage, which has around $75 billion in circulation, enhancing its role in payments and institutional finance.
